title: Evolutionarily Conserved Interactions of RNA Polymerases with TFIIH via a Common Acidic Tail of the RPB6 Subunit.
authors: Okuda, Masahiko; Yoshimura, Yuriko; Hayashi, Aki; Nakayama, Jun-Ichi; Nishimura, Yoshifumi
one_liner_zh: 该文通过NMR和对接模型研究RNA聚合酶RPB6酸性尾部与TFIIH的保守互作，属于广义蛋白-DNA相关转录机制，但非TF-DNA结合建模，方法以实验为主，AI/物理模拟有限。
abstract: In eukaryotes, the three RNA polymerases (RNAPs) share a flexible acidic N-terminal tail (NTT) derived from the common subunit RPB6. In human, NTT interacts with the PH domain (PH-D) of the p62 subunit in the general transcription/repair factor TFIIH. Although the respective binding sites are highly conserved in vertebrates, they are poorly conserved in fungi. Here, using NMR spectroscopy, we reveal that in the fission yeast Schizosaccharomyces pombe, NTT interacts with PH-D via a distinct binding mode. In human, NTT adopts a defined structure on the basic surface of PH-D, sequentially forming an acidic string, inserting phenylalanine into a pocket, contributing an acidic beta-strand to a beta-sheet with PH-D, and inserting valine into another pocket. In S. pombe, by contrast, NTT adopts the acidic string and inserts phenylalanine but neither contributes a beta-strand nor inserts valine, suggesting that the former features constitute the core binding elements, whereas the latter provide additional interaction modules. Docking models of S. pombe RNAPs and TFIIH support NTT as a suitable binding platform for TFIIH and suggest that it has a role in transcription elongation and DNA repair. Moreover, substitutions of acidic residues within the NTT affect the stability of Rpb6 in S. pombe cells, and mutant cells expressing Rpb6 variants with selected substitutions exhibit increased sensitivity to methyl methanesulfonate (MMS), which induces DNA damage repaired by nucleotide excision. Collectively, our findings provide structural insight into the conserved function of RPB6 NTT in RNAP-mediated processes.
abstract_zh: 在真核生物中，三种RNA聚合酶（RNAPs）共享一个源自共同亚基RPB6的柔性酸性N端尾部（NTT）。在人类中，NTT与通用转录/修复因子TFIIH中p62亚基的PH结构域（PH-D）相互作用。尽管各自的结合位点在脊椎动物中高度保守，但在真菌中保守性较差。在此，我们利用核磁共振波谱（NMR spectroscopy）揭示，在裂殖酵母粟酒裂殖酵母（Schizosaccharomyces pombe）中，NTT通过一种不同的结合模式与PH-D相互作用。在人类中，NTT在PH-D的碱性表面上采用明确的结构，依次形成酸性串，将苯丙氨酸插入口袋，贡献酸性β链与PH-D形成β折叠，并将缬氨酸插入另一个口袋。相比之下，在粟酒裂殖酵母中，NTT采用酸性串并插入苯丙氨酸，但既不贡献β链也不插入缬氨酸，这表明前者特征构成核心结合元件，而后者提供额外的相互作用模块。粟酒裂殖酵母RNAPs和TFIIH的对接模型支持NTT作为TFIIH的合适结合平台，并提示其在转录延伸和DNA修复中发挥作用。此外，NTT内酸性残基的替换影响粟酒裂殖酵母细胞中Rpb6的稳定性，而表达具有选定替换的Rpb6变体的突变细胞对甲基甲烷磺酸盐（MMS）表现出增加的敏感性，MMS诱导由核苷酸切除修复的DNA损伤。总体而言，我们的发现为RPB6 NTT在RNAP介导过程中的保守功能提供了结构见解。
